item.title: SEND reform must mean better support, not fewer rights
item.description: The government’s new SEND reforms offer a rare chance to fix a system that forces families to fight for support. But success will depend on funding capacity properly and protecting learners from unintended consequences The post SEND reform must mean better support, not fewer rights first appeared on FE Week.

item.title: SEND reforms spell diet EHCPs and red herring funding
item.description: Replacing EHCPs with a three-tier system could end the Gladiators-style Gauntlet parents face, unless ministers fix the diagnosis bottleneck that lets affluent families skip the queue The post SEND reforms spell diet EHCPs and red herring funding first appeared on FE Week.
